title: Build photo upload, catalog, and manifest UI with e2e smoke
verify: Authorized user can upload a real Plant photo during check-in
UI displays stable photo, catalog, manifest, sha256, and timeline/export refs without treating them as runtime authority
Unauthorized users cannot access unauthorized photo metadata or files
evidence_required: UI/e2e or smoke evidence for photo upload/catalog flow
Screenshot/export redaction evidence where UI capture exists
constraints: Frontend upload controls do not replace backend validation or authorization
User filenames are display metadata only
UI copy does not imply upload/server availability or cloud sync
invariants: MVP data and artifacts remain local/private by default
Secrets/auth material cannot enter screenshots, exports, UI Feed, or agent context
